summary: Experienced IT Architect and integration & cloud platform leader with over ten years of designing and delivering scalable, cloud‑native systems, including Kubernetes‑based platforms, event‑driven architectures, and SaaS‑style solutions. Proven track record in building and operating integration platforms, distributed systems, and AI‑adjacent workflows, with a strong focus on reliability, observability, DevOps, and full‑stack backend development. Combines hands‑on technical expertise with platform leadership, enabling close collaboration with product, engineering, and AI‑related initiatives to drive modern, cloud‑native architectures.
highlights: Cloud & Scale: Delivered a scalable platform supporting 200+ critical integrations in a multi-million SEK initiative.
Product development: Built a digital solution with Java for a Swedish agency, saving thousands of SEK per day.
Leadership & Delivery: Regularly led cross-functional teams of 20+ staff across technical and operational domains.
